en: In a movable pulley, two sections of rope support the load — each section carries half the weight, so only half the total weight force is needed to lift it.

en: If a mixture has iron and something else like sand, you can use a magnet to separate them. The tiny iron pieces stick to the magnet, but the sand does not. This is a clever physical way to separate a mixture.
